question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Sachin Tendulkar was an __indispensable__ member of the Indian cricket team in his days.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Essential.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"indispensable"** means something that is absolutely necessary or essential; it cannot be done without. (अत्यावश्यक)

 
 
• **Example:** Water is indispensable for all living beings.
 
 
 
• **"Essential"** refers to something that is absolutely necessary; extremely important. (आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example:** Food, water, and shelter are essential for survival.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'indispensable'** is **'essential'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Essential**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Motivational** (प्रेरणादायक): Providing inspiration or encouragement.

 
 
• **Example:** His motivational speech inspired everyone to pursue their dreams.
 
 
 
• **Optional** (वैकल्पिक): Available to be chosen but not obligatory.
 
 
• **Example:** Attendance at the seminar is optional but highly recommended.
 
 
 
• **Functional** (कार्यात्मक): Having a special activity, purpose, or task; relating to the way in which something works or operates.
 
 
• **Example:** The new design is not only aesthetic but also highly functional.
